# OpenFurqan

> A free, modern Quran reader for reading, studying, and listening to the Quran online.

Website: https://openfurqan.com

## About

OpenFurqan is a free, open web application for reading and studying the Holy Quran. It provides the full Arabic text of the Quran alongside translations in multiple languages, word-by-word analysis, audio recitation, prayer times, and study tools. No account or payment is required. The interface is available in English, Bangla, and Urdu.

## Content

- 114 Surahs (chapters) of the Holy Quran
- 6,236 Ayahs (verses) with full Arabic text
- 22+ translations across 9+ languages
- Word-by-word Arabic analysis

## Translations Available

English: Sahih International, Yusuf Ali, Pickthall, Arberry, Haleem, Muhsin Khan, Taqi Usmani, Ahmed Raza, Maarif-ul-Quran, Maududi, Transliteration
Bangla: Muhiuddin Khan, Hoque, Mokhtasar, Tafsir Ahsanul-Bayaan
Urdu: Bayan-ul-Quran, Kanzu al-Iman
German: Bubenheim
Spanish: Cortes
French: Hamidullah
Hindi: Hindi, Tafsir Farooq
Turkish: Suleyman Ates

## Features

- Read the Quran online with clean, distraction-free design
- Multiple translations side by side
- Audio recitation by multiple reciters
- Word-by-word Arabic meanings and analysis
- Prayer times based on user location
- Bookmarks and personal notes
- Dark and light themes
- Works on desktop, tablet, and mobile
- Offline support (Progressive Web App)
- No ads, no accounts, completely free

## URL Structure

- Homepage: https://openfurqan.com
- Surah page: https://openfurqan.com/surah/{surah-slug}
- Ayah page: https://openfurqan.com/surah/{surah-slug}/{ayah-number}
